summary: No change: submission.json again contains only a rationale, adding no sources, investigations, knowledge, gaps, interpretations or experiment. Validation was read-only and reported valid with no diagnostics. The run's record is complete for what this session could establish - every question is explained with a retained receipt or an explicit source-only basis, there are no open necessary gaps, and no execution lacks an interpretation - so the only remaining actions available are restating recorded mechanisms or requesting an experiment that the expiring budget could not interpret, both of which would be budget-filling rather than useful investigation. Expiry preserves the retained evidence and needs no closing call; the findings, their receipts, counterevidence and limitations stand for human review of defect validity, CFT relevance and deduplication.
